name: Me Petting My Cat Simulator
source:
A game where you go across the timelines looking for... something? After a nuclear bomb drops,
the ultimate goal? Don't die to the bomb! Simple as that... right?

A mix of Henry Stickmin and DSaF, and by that a mean a lot of choices, different endings, and a shit load of stock images.

[From [url=https://gamejolt.com/games/mepettingmycatongamejolt-ireallyhopetheylikeit-/706396]GameJolt[/url]]
translation:
一款让你穿越时间线寻找……某物的游戏？核弹落下后，
最终目标是什么？不要死于炸弹！就这么简单…对吧？

Henry Stickmin和DSaF的混合体，这意味着有很多选择、不同的结局和大量的库存图像。

[来自[url=https://gamejolt.com/games/mepettingmycatongamejolt-ireallyhopetheylikeit-/706396]GameJolt[/url]]
